line.comment: * Called from game start.
* Task -1.
* === Production Cycles ===
* Cycles are in seconds.
* Add-Ons 1.9.3: Added M3.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Halved capital ship times (M1: 4 hours -> 2 hours; M2: 6 hours -> 3 hours; M7: 2 hours -> 1 hour) to support larger quotas.
* === Base invasion quotas. ===
* These are Normal-difficulty values.
* Difficulty scaling is applied dynamically below.
* Smaller quotas mean the OCV sends invasion fleets sooner, but they're easier to defeat.
* Easy: -25%
* Normal: baseline
* Hard: +33%
* Insane: +75%
* Production priority iterates from tail to head.
* ZH 2.0 - Phanon quest.
* During the Xenon crisis, we delay the portal destruction to keep things simple.
* Add-Ons 1.7: NPC scaling based on player's suppy usage.
* This is calculated in ZH.Calculate.Scaling, called once per hour in ZH.Monitor.
* Cannot be lower than 100.
* === Determine whether another ship must be produced. ===
* Check what we have and what we need.
* Store shortages so production priority can be selected after checking all classes.
* M1/M2 retain their special difficulty quotas.
* Easy/Normal/Hard = 2, Insane = 3.
* Apply general difficulty scaling.
* Add 50 before division to round to the nearest integer.
* Add-Ons 1.7: Scale quotas with player supply usage.
* No additional scaling if the player is allied with the OCV.
* Add-Ons 1.8.1: Halved OCV forces if the player allied with the OCV.
* Grind larger reserves before invading again.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Count all waiting OCV ships in the portal sector except active portal invaders.
* Persistent portal defense is handled by the Xenon.
* Maximum batch size for this production cycle.
* We have everything required. Reform the waiting OCV ships into invasion fleets.
* Mayhem.ReformTerraformer handles carrier restocking and calls Mayhem.OCV.CreateInvaders.
* Select the next deficient class to produce.
* M3/M4/M6 are fast bulk-production classes and are replenished first.
* M7 is produced 2 at at ime.
* M1/M2 are produced individually.
* M1/M2 build individually.
* M7s build up to 2 at a time.
* M3/M4/M6 replenish their full deficit.
* Close invasion ready
* === Continue current production. ===
* Reset every 8h by ZH.Core.
* Add-Ons 1.7.1: Exceeding the supply factor speeds up OCV production.
* Add-Ons 2.0.2: Cycle is reduced depending on the number of gates.
* Maelstrom counts as a gate, so 2 gates is the baseline: 100%.
* Each additional gate increases the rate by 25%, up to 200% if in a 4-way sector with a jump hole.
* Add-Ons 2.0.2: Production is 50% faster on hard and 100% faster on insane.
* OCV-aligned players do not receive the Insane production bonus.
* Add-Ons 2.2: In origin galaxies, OCV production operates at 25% speed during the first 24 hours.
* A 75% reduction in production rate quadruples the production cycle.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Smaller batches complete proportionally faster.
* Example: Building 10 ships from a maximum batch of 15 takes 10/15 of the normal cycle.
* Add-Ons 2.0.2: Fighters and M6 build in batches.
* Add-Ons 2.2: M7s build two at a time. M1/M2 build individually.
* Integrate newly produced ships into the waiting OCV fleet.
* ZH 2.0 - Maelstrom shutdown
